findings.title: Adding journal entries multiplies a plant's harvest count and harvest weight
findings.where: GET /api/plants and /api/plants/{id}; the plants list and the plant detail page
findings.expected: Courgette has 1 harvest of 1.2 kg, so harvest_count stays 1 and harvest_grams stays 1200 after journal entries are added
findings.actual: With 2 journal entries the API returns harvest_count 2 and harvest_grams 2400. The detail page shows '2.4 kg total, 2 harvests, averaging 1.2 kg each' above a table with only one harvest row. The new LEFT JOIN on journal_entries multiplies the harvest rows that COUNT(h.id) and SUM(h.weight_grams) add up.
